narrative.overview: Classora is a Vietnamese-first workspace for running a training center's day. It uses a compact indigo application frame, white operational surfaces, jade actions, and dense readable data so the interface feels current without becoming a generic analytics dashboard.
keyCharacteristics: Indigo authenticated frame with persistent tenant identity
Jade reserved for primary operations and active states
Mineral-white workspace with grouped white surfaces
Compact Vietnamese-first typography and dense readable tables

rules.name: Operational Honesty
rules.body: Every surface, metric, and control must support real center operations and real data.

rules.name: Structural Indigo
rules.body: Indigo owns navigation, links, and focus; jade owns actions and positive states.

rules.name: Compact Clarity
rules.body: Use grouped information and dense tables without oversized cards or ornamental hierarchy.

dos: Do keep the current center identity visible in the authenticated shell.
Do use meaningful grouping for operational details and forms.
Do preserve semantic tables, labels, focus states, and reduced motion.
donts: Don't add metrics, charts, search, notifications, or future navigation without working product behavior.
Don't use gradients, glassmorphism, oversized cards, or heavy shadows.
Don't introduce another component library or a generic page factory.
